description: This file defines an implementation of a resource node within a policy enforcement tree structure, including methods for managing child nodes, permissions, and traversal within the tree.

classes.name: ResourceNode
classes.description: Implementation of {@link PolicyTreeNode} for resource nodes, representing resources in a permission policy tree, with capabilities for hierarchy management, permission checks, and pointer calculations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ResourceNode with default permissions or specified permissions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this resource node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the node type, which is RESOURCE.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by its resource name.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns all children of this node.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this resource node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing {@link Visitor} and traverses this node and its children.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node if exists.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions associated with this node.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions for this node.

methods.name: isGranted
methods.description: Checks if specific permissions are granted and not revoked.

methods.name: areAllGranted
methods.description: Checks if all specified permissions are granted and none are revoked.

methods.name: areAllRevoked
methods.description: Checks if all specified permissions are revoked.

methods.name: getAbsolutePointer
methods.description: Computes and returns the absolute JSON pointer for this resource node.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the depth level of this node within its tree.
